about: Synthetic, with the real letter's structures in other words: 'Even if you are NOT credentialed ... if an emergency circumstance comes up ..., those services fall within ...', 'Whether or not ...', 'In the event you are asked to provide ...', 'you are required to render emergency care ..., which means ...' (a duty of care, not a document), capitals and asterisks for emphasis, a thanks-for-calling opener, 'We will be addressing this with the facility', and a signature with a title and phone numbers. No physician name is given, as in the real case, so the agreement's own sentence (which names the physician) is not quoted and its 'effective on' words alone are. It asks for nothing.
subject: Re: Emergency cases at Kestrel Valley
body:
Hi Dr. Testa,

Thanks for calling this morning. As promised, here is where the agency stands on the emergency cases at Kestrel Valley Example Hospital.

Your provider agreement with us DOES cover emergency care, and it has no exclusion for the kind of case you described. Under *Section 6.2 (Malpractice Insurance)*, Harrowgate Medical Staffing provides professional liability coverage for every shift you work through us, at $500,000 per occurrence and $1,500,000 aggregate, raised where state law requires more.

Even if you are NOT credentialed at Kestrel Valley for pediatric trauma, if an emergency circumstance comes up while you are on shift, those services fall within the *insured work* of the policy. Whether or not the case is on your privilege list, care you give to stabilize a patient in an emergency is insured. In the event you are asked to provide urgent treatment outside your usual case mix, that treatment is insured too, on the standard policy terms. When on call you are required to render emergency care, which means those cases are part of your shift and insured.

We will be addressing this with the facility directly so that it does not happen again.

Best regards,

Morgan Ellery
Clinical Placement Manager | Emergency Medicine Division
Harrowgate Medical Staffing
Direct: (303) 555-0126
Mobile: (720) 555-0164 (call or text)
